title: Skill matrix
subtitle: Each developer's level per skill. Supervisors / Managers verify levels; Project Leaders use them to staff projects.
subtitleOwn: Your own skill levels. Click a cell to assess yourself — a Supervisor or Manager verifies it.
noSkills: No active skills — add some under Manage skills.
selfOnlyOwner: Only the person can set their own self-assessment.
verifiedHelp: Your confirmed rating — it is the one used in scoring.
verifiedOnlyAssessor: Set by a Supervisor or Manager.
deactivateHelp: Turn a skill off instead of deleting it: levels already recorded are kept, but it is hidden from the matrix and from new requirements.

legend.stale: Not updated for over a year

1.name: Aware
1.hint: has tried it or is learning

4.name: Advanced

fit.requirementsIntro: What this project needs. Used to rank developers below — the required level is the level someone needs to work on it independently.
fit.weightHelp: 1 = nice to have … 5 = core of the project
fit.noRequirementsManage: No skill requirements yet — add the skills this project needs to get developer recommendations.
fit.needRequirements: Add at least one skill requirement to see recommendations.
fit.formula: Score = skill {skill}% · availability {availability}% · on-time track record {track}% · same project type {domain}%.
fit.noType: This project has no project type, so the domain part is left out.

why.skill: Covers {value}% of the weighted skill requirements
why.load: {projects} other active projects · {items} open tasks / bugs
why.track: {onTime} of {done} tasks on time in the last 12 months
why.domain: {count} earlier projects of the same type

fit.disclaimer: A recommendation to support the decision, not an assignment — check workload and development goals with the people involved.
